headline: Northern Bridge Hit on the Roadway as Merz Arrives by Special Train
deck: Merz reached Kyiv by special train Sunday morning. A drone then hit the Northern Bridge over the Dnipro. Three of six city road bridges were already restricted this week.
body: Chancellor Friedrich Merz reached Kyiv by special train on Sunday morning with Economy Minister Katherina Reiche and ten defence and energy executives [E1][E2][E3][E8]. After he arrived, a Russian attack set off a drone alarm in the city [E4].
Mayor Vitali Klitschko reported an impact on the roadway of the Northern Bridge, hit again by a Russian drone over the Dnipro on Sunday morning [E5][E6].
Debris from a shot-down flying object fell on the roof of a residential building [E7].
Russian assaults earlier this week forced the full or partial closure of three of Kyiv's six road bridges over the Dnipro, suspending traffic and causing tailbacks [E9].
